item: test_guard_sweep link-stats test removed the Source/Article/ArticleLink rows it left in the shared engine, which made test_discovery_isolation's bulk DELETE FROM articles fail on article_links (no ON DELETE CASCADE)
summary: Measured over a subset run (the CI file list up to test_discovery_isolation.py; CI itself runs the whole suite in one alphabetical process) with a plugin logging articles + the FK-child counts of articles after each test: the one leaker of a non-cascading ARTICLE child table. Not measured: non-cascading children of sources (source_metadata, source_group_association), which the same fixture's DELETE FROM sources also meets. Pair guard_sweep-then-discovery: 1 passed 3 errors before, 3 passed after. CI's alphabetical order runs discovery first, so it stayed green. Victim fixture deliberately unchanged.
